columnHints.TRAC_NGHIEM: Required: Content, Answer A-D, Correct answer (1 letter A-D). Optional: Image URL (question image). Reference passage (shared reading passage) — only shown to students if ≥2 CONSECUTIVE rows share the EXACT SAME value here (merged into one group). Passage format: separate paragraphs/dialogue turns with ONE BLANK LINE; the FIRST paragraph auto-becomes a bold centered TITLE if short (≤100 chars) with no mid-sentence punctuation; a paragraph shaped "Name: content" (e.g. "Tom: I go to a big school...") auto-splits "Name" onto its own bold line (mirrors printed dialogue).
columnHints.TRAC_NGHIEM_VOICE: Required: Content, Answer A-D, Correct answer, Audio URL. Optional: Image URL. Reference passage (= audio transcript) — no required format on its own; if used to group several questions sharing one audio/passage, follow the SAME passage rules as Multiple choice (see above): blank line between paragraphs, short first paragraph becomes the title, "Name: content" lines auto-split the name.
columnHints.DIEN_TU: Required: Content, Correct answer (1 word/phrase — multiple accepted answers separated by /). Optional: Image URL.
columnHints.NGHE_DIEN_TU: Required: Content, Audio URL, Correct answer (1 value).
columnHints.DIEN_TU_NHOM: 1 row creates N separate questions. Required: Content (N sentences separated by |), Correct answer (N answers separated by |, matching count). Optional: Image URL (N images separated by |), Audio URL (shared across the group). Reference passage is AUTO-DETECTED from its content: a short word list separated by COMMAS (e.g. "activity, advanced, beginner") → treated as a shared reference word bank; LONG text (>200 chars) OR text containing sentence punctuation (./!/?) → treated as a REAL context passage, shown verbatim to students, NO word bank built.
columnHints.TU_LUAN: Required: Content. Optional: Image URL, Explanation (= grading rubric).
columnHints.SPEAKING: Required: Content, Reference passage (= keywords/phonemes to grade, listed separated by COMMAS by convention, e.g. "enthusiasm, literature, variety"). NOTE: this field is currently NOT shown to the teacher on the "Grading queue" screen — it's stored only; grading stays fully manual by ear, no AI involved.
columnHints.DIEN_TU_HOP_TU_VUNG: Required: Content, Correct answer (N blanks separated by |). No word bank/image.
columnHints.DIEN_TU_HOP_TU_VUNG_ANH: Required: Content, Correct answer (N blanks separated by |). Optional: Image URL. Reference passage (= reference word bank) — list words separated by COMMAS, e.g. "under, next to, behind, in front of, on" — leave empty to default the bank to the correct answers. Students pick via a dropdown.
columnHints.DIEN_TU_DOAN_VAN: Same as Fill in the blank - Word bank (with image) — Content, Correct answer (N blanks separated by |, empty elements allowed), optional Image URL. Reference passage (= reference word bank), COMMA-separated exactly like Fill in the blank - Word bank (with image) — the difference is students TYPE into an input instead of picking from a dropdown.
columnHints.NGHE_PHIEU_THONG_TIN: Required: Content, Audio URL, Correct answer (N blanks separated by |, multiple accepted answers per blank separated by /). Content SUPPORTS the exact multi-line form layout from a real worksheet (e.g. "The Sea Lady / Main Facts: / Built in: (14)___..."): the FIRST line/paragraph standing alone (separated from the rest by ONE BLANK LINE, i.e. press Alt+Enter twice in Excel), if short (≤100 chars, no mid-sentence punctuation) → auto-becomes a bold centered TITLE (e.g. "The Sea Lady"); the rest of the body KEEPS every line break exactly as typed (shows as multiple lines/sections); wrap text in double asterisks "**text**" to render sub-heading labels BOLD (e.g. "**Main Facts:**", "**Dinner:**") — this is NOT automatic, you must add the ** yourself. The number of ___ in Content must match the number of answers in Correct answer. Optional: Reference passage = ONLY a single shared instruction line shown above the whole form (e.g. "Write one or two words or a number or a date or a time.") — do NOT put the form body here; the full form (title + sub-headings + blanks) goes entirely in Content as described above. Keep Reference passage to one line (see the line-break limitation note for this field).
columnHints.SAP_XEP_CAU: Required: Content, Correct answer (≥2 chunks separated by |, in order).
columnHints.SAP_XEP_CHU_CAI: Required: Content, Correct answer (≥2 letters separated by |). Optional: Image URL.
columnHints.NGHE_NOP_AUDIO: Required: Content, Audio URL. Graded manually.
columnHints.NGHE_CHON_HINH: Required: Content, Audio URL, Image URL (N images separated by |, 1 per answer in A-D order). Optional: Answer A-D (captions under each image), Correct answer. Reference passage (= audio transcript), no special format required.
columnHints.DOC_HIEU_LUOI: 1 row creates N questions sharing one answer set. Required: Content (N questions separated by |), Answer A-D (shared by EVERY question, NOT | separated), Correct answer (N letters separated by |). Reference passage is REQUIRED, shared by the whole group — follows the SAME passage rules as Multiple choice: one blank line between paragraphs/dialogue turns, short first paragraph becomes the bold title, "Name: content" lines auto-split the name (e.g. the Tom/Max/Anna sample passage).
columnHints.DOC_DIEN_TU: 1 row creates N blanks, each with its own answer set. Required: Answer A (N options separated by |, used to infer blank count), Correct answer (N letters separated by |). Optional: Answer B/C/D (same count as column A), Content (= N blank labels, leave empty to auto-number). Reference passage is REQUIRED, with NUMBERED blanks like (1)___, (2)___... inline — follows the same display rules (blank line between paragraphs, title/name auto-split) as Reading comprehension - Grid.
